reviews.comment: I overall enjoyed this class but I barely got an A because we are graded by so few things (I messed up exam 1). His exams are 80% math but he goes over the exact questions he will put on the exam in class so it's pretty easy to succeed. He's a very generous grader and gave a lot of extra points and partial credit on the exams!

His lectures were so boring, and there was participation, so it's not something you can skip. This is a MATH-heavy course, even though he only goes over calculus 1-3 times before each unit exam (go figure). 80% of each exam are write-out math questions, even though 90% of his class consists of conceptual-based topics. I wouldn't take this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course is very math heavy so if you are terrible at math, perhaps consider another course. That being said, if you practice the test review sheets (which are the almost the EXACT same questions as the ones on the test), you should have no trouble of pulling off an A. Attend lectures as they are CRITICAL for doing well. Nice professor too!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was decent. The material can be difficult to understand at times since it's extremely math heavy, but if you take the time to understand it then you'll be fine. The tests are fairly easy to study for since he gives a study guide. Overall, good professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Klopack is honestly amazing! I was in his ECON425 class in fall 2022 and I absolutely loved him! Lecture exams are hard but if you follow his objectives and skim through your readings you will be okay. Preparation is good for his lectures. You can tell he really cares, he gives tough love.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and boring (practice problems are done in class, but they are also long and feel like him talking at us). Get an A by studying the practice problems, class slides, and homeworks for the exams. I don't recommend this class if you are the kind of student that does well in classes that are less lecture heavy and more engaging.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Klopack really wants you to succeed, and if you show that you care and put in effort, he will take great notice of that. There are not a lot of grades, but he is also not a tough grader. I have a lot of respect for him, and he is very passionate about IO. He takes attendance, but it is important to show up or you will not do well.

He has a great understanding of the topic and does a good job preparing you for homework and tests. His classes are very lecture heavy, takes attendance, and gives HW, but if you enjoy the topic then lectures are interesting enough to get through. The paper isn't bad and gives clear guidelines. Overall good prof, nice guy, but keeps his distance.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were long winded and were expected to sit through with minimal breaks. Prof Klopack is an easy grader and will basically pass you if you show up. The tests and homework weren't too bad but if you want a prof who is concerned or who has classroom morale/expectations that are consistent with his syllabus, you may want to reconsider.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tests weren't too hard and he curved all of them. As long as you show all your work on the homework you'll get 100, he grades based on if you tried no necessarily if you got the right answers. Posts old exam questions for practice before exams that help a lot. Lectures are helpful too.
